c2a-beep-help: Tap arrows to build Beep’s plan. Tap a plan card to replace it, insert before it, or remove it. Press Go to follow the plan. Help shows one next edit. Your plan stays if Beep bumps.
c2a-beep-dare-three: Try the picture dare: no bumps or missed runs. Help keeps your finish, without a dare mark.
c2a-beep-dare-four: Try the picture dare: one fix, one Go. Help keeps your finish, without a dare mark.
c2a-beep-dare-five: Try the picture dare: use only four cards. Help keeps your finish, without a dare mark.
c2a-beep-again: Again times two makes two moves total with the arrow before it. Again times three makes three moves total.
